repos.name: Advanced-AI-Workflows
repos.base_note: origin/main last moved 2026-06-08; all week's work is unmerged on the branch, so the branch was used as the base and the finding disclosed

highlights: Eleven PRs merged in a single day (#3-#13), every one green on six required checks
v0.17.0 tagged, pushed and released - the repo's first GitHub Release
Test insertion ratio 29% -> 50%; one defect class (checks whose subject is an interpolated string) found and swept across three audits, three guards and two installers
improve: AAW main has not moved since 2026-06-08 while 111 commits accumulated on a branch
60% of commits are fixes, and the top four hotspots are files edited 7-16 times in a week - the installers were reworked repeatedly rather than designed once
Verification scripts went unverified: a shell collection diff emitted 'added: 0, removed: 0' from two empty files, reproducing the release's own defect class inside the check for it
habits: Every fix proven by restoring the pre-fix code byte-for-byte and confirming the new test fails against it
Refuse to report on an empty subject - the check that cannot fail is the one to distrust
Land through PRs with an evidence table, not direct pushes to main
